findings.description: Numeric output caps were required but acceptable cap values were not constrained.
findings.suggestedAction: Add hard SRS ceilings for fixture cap values.

findings.description: pathPrefix fail-or-redact wording was slightly ambiguous for a source-relative-only filter.
findings.suggestedAction: Require validation failure with redacted error payloads for unsafe pathPrefix values.

resolution: CON-MCP-010 supersedes CON-MCP-009 with hard numeric output cap ceilings and strict source-relative pathPrefix validation failure semantics.
